page: Amazon Web Services c7i.metal-48xl is a bare-metal compute-optimized server powered by Intel Xeon 8488C processors built on the x86_64 architecture. The platform delivers 96 physical cores and 192 dedicated vCPUs operating at a nominal clock speed of 3.2 GHz. Memory is provisioned with 384.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 RAM running at 5 GHz, reflecting a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware-level acceleration features include Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 vector instruction sets, paired with a 105 MB L3 cache.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional parallel processing capabilities. In multi-core assessments, the system reaches top-tier standing with a stress-ng score of 171,174.13, a PassMark CPU score of 125,745.92, and a Clang software compilation score of 58,941.0. Cache-heavy and vectorized tasks benefit significantly from the underlying Sapphire Rapids architecture, producing top-tier results in PassMark CPU extended instructions and encryption. Memory throughput is substantial, exceeding 423 GB/sec in large-block read testing. In-memory data store performance is similarly elevated, registering 191.08 million Redis SET operations per second.

Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 50 Gbps, providing ample interface bandwidth for clustered nodes and high-throughput network applications. In terms of storage architecture, the server includes no local NVMe storage drives, necessitating external network-attached volume storage such as Amazon EBS for persistent data operations. Similarly, no discrete GPU accelerators are installed, relying instead on integrated AMX instructions for tensor and int8 matrix calculations.

Given the high core density and standard compute-optimized memory ratio, the server yields strong hardware efficiency for massively multi-threaded workloads. The c7i.metal-48xl is suited for continuous integration build farms, distributed CPU-bound computational modeling, large-scale Redis deployments, static web delivery clusters, and CPU-based LLM inference pipelines.
description: Amazon Web Services c7i.metal-48xl is a bare-metal compute-optimized instance equipped with 96-core, 192-thread Intel Xeon 8488C processors clocked at 3.2 GHz and 384.0 GB of 5 GHz DDR5 memory. Featuring Intel AMX and AVX-512 instruction set extensions, the x86_64 platform achieves top-tier results across multi-core computing benchmarks, software compilation suites, and cryptographic tests. Network bandwidth provides a 50 Gbps baseline, facilitating heavy network interchange. The configuration omits local disk drives and discrete GPU hardware, relying on external network storage for file systems. With a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB of memory per core, this server delivers dedicated physical access optimized for high-concurrency tasks, including automated build farms, CPU-driven batch processing, distributed caching services, and large-scale web serving environments.
